title: DriftWatch ingestion event envelope v1
description: Language-neutral event contract published per Spec_Upgrade.md section 7.1 (Phase 1 deliverable: contract only, not yet wired to a live ingestion endpoint - that is Phase 4).

event_id.description: Stable, collision-resistant identifier (UUID/ULID). Must remain stable across retries so cloud ingestion can dedupe.

occurred_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the underlying observation happened, client-assigned.

received_at.description: UTC timestamp assigned by the receiving server, never trusted from the client.

meta.description: Signal-dependent metadata. Must never contain raw prompt/response content unless the owning project has explicitly opted in to content capture.

content_capture.description: Explicit opt-in flag. False by default per Spec_Upgrade.md section 8.3 - metadata-only unless a project turns this on.
